reviews.review_msg: Paul is an amazing professor. His passion for Italian culture is evident in his cultures, and his courses having no technology involved was amazing and refreshing. 100% recommend taking his courses.
Very positive experience. Paul emphasizes process over final product and wants you to improve your critical and creative thinking without the crutch of AI. Happy with my grade. Excellent prof.
This is a great class. I really like the format, including all writing in class. Will take this prof again.

Paul ran an outstanding class. The films were an interesting mix. Discussions were engaging. The assignments and expectations were challenging but manageable, but you have to put in the work. He's very approachable and gives GREAT feedback during office hours (Zoom). You'll learn a lot about Italy and film from his courses. Enjoyed going to class.
